g.text: Jellyfin: media server on a privileged LXC with QuickSync
Outside K3s on purpose: it needs the host's iGPU. K3s only fronts it with a route.
Jellyfin LXC on Urd · privileged, outside K3s
Sources: docs/services/jellyfin.md, docs/services/media-automation.md. Remote family access is Tailscale. About 10 concurrent heavy 1080p transcodes stay above real time.
